import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker

eo_path = "/root/autodl-tmp/trace-verdict-study-checkpoints/qwen7b_exception_only_dynamics_seed42/dynamics_log.jsonl"
ft_path = "/root/autodl-tmp/trace-verdict-study-checkpoints/qwen7b_full_trace_dynamics_seed42/dynamics_log.jsonl"

def load(path):
    steps, accs = [], []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            d = json.loads(line)
            steps.append(d["step"])
            accs.append(d["accuracy"] * 100)
    return steps, accs

eo_steps, eo_accs = load(eo_path)
ft_steps, ft_accs = load(ft_path)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))

ax.plot(eo_steps, eo_accs, 'o-', color='#2563EB', linewidth=2, markersize=5, label='Exception-Only')
ax.plot(ft_steps, ft_accs, 's--', color='#DC2626', linewidth=2, markersize=5, label='Full Trace')

# Annotate exception_only saturation at step 200
eo_sat_idx = eo_steps.index(200)
ax.annotate(f'{eo_accs[eo_sat_idx]:.2f}%',
            xy=(200, eo_accs[eo_sat_idx]),
            xytext=(260, 97.5),
            fontsize=10,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#2563EB', lw=1.2),
            color='#2563EB', fontweight='bold')

# Annotate full_trace best at step 350
ft_best_idx = ft_steps.index(350)
ax.annotate(f'{ft_accs[ft_best_idx]:.2f}%',
            xy=(350, ft_accs[ft_best_idx]),
            xytext=(380, 92),
            fontsize=10,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#DC2626', lw=1.2),
            color='#DC2626', fontweight='bold')

ax.set_xlabel('Training Step', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Accuracy (%)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_title('Training Dynamics: Exception-Only vs Full Trace', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylim(80, 101)
ax.set_xlim(25, 470)
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(50))
ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(2))
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='-')
ax.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=11, framealpha=0.9)
ax.tick_params(labelsize=10)

plt.tight_layout()
out_base = "/root/trace-verdict-study/docs/paper/figures/training_dynamics"
fig.savefig(out_base + ".pdf", dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
fig.savefig(out_base + ".png", dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Saved:", out_base + ".pdf")
print("Saved:", out_base + ".png")
PYEOF
